title: Macaroni, Spaghetti, Vermicelli and Egg Noodles
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard prescribes the requirements and the methods of sampling and test for macaroni, spaghetti, vermicelli and egg noodles.

marking_requirements: The material shall be packed in cardboard
cartons with a lining of moisture-proof material
paper bags, sealed to prevent ingress of moisture. Tinplate containers may also be used.
food product shall be of food grade quality.
The size of the container is subject to agreement between the purchaser and the supplier.
